title.narrative: Formulation of the fourth phase of Denmark's Peace and Stabilisation Programme for the Horn of Africa

description.narrative: The purpose of this assignment is to support the Danish Embassy in Nairobi in the process of formulating the next programme including identifying and suggesting preparatory analyses for a fourth phase – an assignment of estimated 9 months – with an expected start in April 2022.

With reference to the Process Action Plan below, the process will start with an identification phase to be finalised in May 2022, followed by a formulation phase which is expected to be concluded by the approval of the final programme in November/December 2022. The team of consultants will support the Embassies in Nairobi and Addis Ababa during phase of the programme, specifically in formatting a draft programme document and related annexes including draft Peace and Stabilisation Engagement Documents (PSEDs).
